title: Packing for the coast
explanation: The details, the why, and the format. Every part of the ticket is covered.
ticket: A short packing checklist for a 3-day school trip to the coast, simple enough for a first-timer packing alone.

ingredients.label: The details
ingredients.text: for a 3-day school trip to the coast in June
ingredients.missingHint: The customer is going to the coast for 3 days. Nothing in your order says where or how long.

ingredients.label: The why
ingredients.text: I'm packing by myself for the first time, so only include what I really need.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer is a first-timer packing alone. Your order never says why the list should stay short and simple.

ingredients.label: The format
ingredients.text: Give it as a checklist under three headings: Clothes, Wash bag, Gear. Keep it under 15 items.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer asked for a checklist. Your order never says what shape the answer should take.

outputs.base:
Here's a general packing list:
- Clothes: shirts, pants, underwear, socks, pajamas, a jacket
- Toiletries: toothbrush, toothpaste, shampoo, deodorant
- Electronics: phone, charger, headphones, laptop, power bank
- Documents: ID, passport, tickets, insurance card
- Extras: snacks, water bottle, book, travel pillow
Tell me where you're going and I can tailor it!
outputs.trip:
Packing list for a 3-day coastal school trip:
Clothing: 3 T-shirts, 2 pairs of shorts, 1 pair of long pants, 4 pairs of socks and underwear, swimsuit, light rain jacket, hoodie, sun hat, pajamas, sneakers, sandals.
Toiletries: toothbrush, toothpaste, shampoo, soap, deodorant, hairbrush, sunscreen (SPF 30+), lip balm, insect repellent.
Beach and outdoor: beach towel, sunglasses, reusable water bottle, small backpack, plastic bag for wet clothes.
Other: medication, phone and charger, a book or cards for the bus, some spending money, your signed permission slip.
Check your school's list too, since some trips ban phones or limit bag size.
outputs.why:
Good on you for packing solo! The basics most trips need:
- One change of clothes per day, plus a spare
- Sleepwear
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Any medicine you take
- Phone charger
- A bag for dirty laundry
Where are you going, and for how long? I can make this fit your trip.
